subject: E1.5: block-form nested package (index.t) + pre-pass sub pkg attribution
description: Handle `package o { ... }` inside a sub (index.t 226/278): v1-shape inline (p-defpackage)+(defclass plc-)+(p-set-current-package), push/lower children/restore. Also make the sub pre-pass (add_declared_sub keyed by seg pkg) compute the effective package for named subs nested after a nested package statement (bless.t F::test).
